summary: Hybrid workshop AV kit international transfer and temporary conference-room badge provisioning
description:
Issue summary: A consolidated AV kit (2x cameras, 1x portable mixer, 1x wireless presenter, assorted cables) needs to be shipped from our SF HQ to the Berlin office for a week-long hybrid engineering workshop. The request includes temporary provisioning of conference-room badge access for an external contractor and a short-term locker for equipment storage.

Impact: Workshop starts 2026-03-16. If kit and access are not available on-site the first two days, two cross-team sessions (approx. 40 attendees total) will be impacted and we risk rescheduling. Logistics also require customs paperwork for EU import and a Dol-tier courier booking because some items are battery-powered and require UN3480 handling notes.

Environment: Internal asset movement between Redwood SF (HQ) -> Redwood Berlin (eu-central). No customer data involved.

Request: Coordinate shipping with Global Ops and Facilities, generate proper export/import paperwork, confirm courier that supports lithium batteries, create a temporary conference-room badge for contractor (valid 2026-03-15 through 2026-03-19), and allocate locker S-04 for secure overnight storage.

Attachments/links: Packing list and asset tags in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AvKitWorkshop; Shipping runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/AV-Shipping-Runbook
steps_to_reproduce: 2) Ops attempted to generate export declaration but battery classification missing from asset record.
3) Attempted to reserve locker via facilities portal; locker S-04 shows as reserved (conflict).
4) Contractor badge request submitted to SSO but failed automated provisioning due to missing corporate email domain.
5) Courier quotes returned but none explicitly listed UN3480 handling for the battery type; need explicit confirmation.
impact: Potential delay to workshop start, risk of equipment being held at customs, and inability for external facilitator to access the conference room for setup.
environment: prod | eu-central (Berlin) and us-west (San Francisco HQ)
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Maya Chen: Filing ticket after facilities form returned validation errors for battery items and locker conflict. Need Ops help to get export declaration and courier confirmation.
2026-03-10 10:45 - Liam O'Connor (assigned): Acknowledged. I'll ping #facilities and Global Ops for courier options that handle UN3480. Also will check locker ownership and escalate if needed.
2026-03-10 11:30 - Facilities (Elena Ruiz): Locker S-04 currently held for recurring bookings MWF by Team Payments; can we request temporary swap to S-07? If not, advise alternate secure storage.
2026-03-11 08:22 - Global Ops (Raj Patel): I requested quotes from two couriers (DHL Pro, FedEx Custom Critical). DHL needs a battery spreadsheet with cell-level details. Sending template to Liam.
2026-03-11 14:05 - Liam O'Connor: Contractor (external) does not have a Redwood email; submitted a one-off guest badge request to ITSSO with host approval. Waiting on SSO manual approval.
investigation_notes: Confirmed asset tags and serial numbers in asset inventory but battery chemistry field blank for 3 items (camera batteries and mixer internal battery).
Locker S-04 conflict: recurring reservation by Team Payments. Facilities proposed S-07 as alternative; S-07 requires minor key rekeying (estimated 2 business days).
SSO guest badges require completed visitor agreement and host approval; contractor provided signed agreement 2026-03-11 09:00.
Customs: shipping value under EUR 1,000 qualifies for simplified import, but battery classification still necessary for courier acceptance.
resolution: Workaround: Reserved locker S-12 (adjacent floor) as interim storage; arranged on-site handover to Berlin Ops lead on 2026-03-15 at 09:00. DHL Pro confirmed conditional pickup but required completed battery spreadsheet. Final: Batteries were classified using manufacturer datasheets (attached to Drive). DHL Pro provided UN3480 handling confirmation and pickup scheduled 2026-03-13 16:00 PST. Guest badge created manually by ITSSO and validated for contractor access 2026-03-15 through 2026-03-19. Follow-up: Add battery chemistry to asset inventory schema to prevent future delays and update AV-Shipping-Runbook with explicit lithium battery checklist.
notes_for_follow_up: 1) Add mandatory battery fields to asset onboarding flow. 2) Pre-authorize one-off guest badge workflow for contractor facilitators. 3) Prebook alternate locker pool for event equipment to avoid recurring reservation conflicts.
final_status_notes: In-progress actions: courier pickup confirmed, guest badge issued, locker reassigned to S-12. Pending: update asset inventory schema and runbook (owner: Facilities).
